mostWorthwhile.text: Making dung beetles and connecting them to soil was the most worthwhile passage: it gave nutrient recycling a concrete place in the grassland.

leastWorthwhile.text: The hunting ground, watering place and predator-prey sequence made sense, but felt like several intermediate steps toward one connection.

surprise.text: Grazing herds plus decomposition produced dung beetles, a more specific recycling link than I expected.

arbitrary.text: Eyes plus Air felt arbitrary when chosen: I was guessing at its purpose, although tracking senses became useful for making predators.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the concrete ecological connections and the final food web offer a compelling sense of a world acting beyond individual creations, despite some repetitive intermediates.
